title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 As seen above, a large number of prison inmates are undergoing/engaged in various vocational programmes. Uttar Pradesh, which was mainly engaged in adult education of the prisoners (5228) has reported involvement of the highest number of jail inmates. This was followed by UT of Delhi (1257) and States of Karnataka (1134) and Tamil Nadu (407).
